accepted.sentence: A narrow, flattened blade at the tip fits into a straight groove in a fastener head.
A pointed tip with four tapered flutes is shaped to seat in a cross-shaped recess.
Some shafts have a hexagonal exterior that provides flat surfaces for applying extra turning force.
A hole through the handle end can provide a place to hang the tool on a peg.
Certain hollow handles contain spare interchangeable tips within a compartment.
Models intended for electrical work may have an insulating coating over the shaft and handle.
A compact version pairs a short shaft with a broad handle for use in confined spaces.
A metal collar where the shaft enters the handle can reinforce the joint against impact and stress.
